result: Negative result confirmed again: the strategy's log-height estimator (expected_bound=3.7) is an incompatible theoretical baseline for GNFS polynomial selection. The correct coefficient bound B=N^(1/(d+1)) for N=100003, d=4 is 10.0001 (ratio 2.70x). The polynomial passes the coefficient bound check (max_coeff=2 < B=10.0001) but the bound claim is 2.7x wrong. Discriminant=189.0 < N^(2/3)≈21544 for this polynomial at N=100003 — it is a valid candidate for relation collection at small N but the discriminant threshold matters at scale. The R3 test (genus-6 curves, Riemann-Roch) remains deferred per accepted_continuation and requires Sage/Magma.
